performance_condition: Prompt polling/return/publication of complete packet prefix while other copies can remain inflight; stable finite ring capacity is a real resource dependency. This supports a falsifiable delivery/reuse question but not a measured performance loss or any particular numeric rate/deadline.
B_guest_consume_and_repost: Outside the frozen backend implementation; notify/used publication is evidenced, actual guest execution or B reuse timing is not observed.
mapping_projection: Same single backend owner/domain may be a controlled projection; native VM isolation and actual DMA hardware topology not established.
completion: Every exact packet span must retire before prefix publication; 503B is not complete packet3.
header_cache_dependency: Native header is CPU-written before async payload. A bounded adapter may order header differently if ownership and costs explicit; no free coherence assumption.
ordinary_controls: direct CPU copy plus lawful publication
one DMA interleaving copy/poll and whole-packet delivery
multi DMA ordinary per-queue FIFO/complete-prefix publication
large/resident mapping, batching, stable pool, lawful layout and no-copy alternatives where ownership permits
source_recovery: vhost logs DMA error but does not handle error at vhost level; copy failure calls for stopping async datapath. Platform must conservatively retain/quarantine uncertain ownership.
platform_gate: pending dedicated platform result; no new G0 contract unless existing safe handoff path and source-backed target accepted.
